advice: Admit. Do NOT give systemic steroids (risk of rebound). Watch for sepsis, hypocalcaemia, hypoalbuminaemia. Avoid known triggers (steroid withdrawal, infections, pregnancy).

name: Generalised pustular psoriasis (inpatient)

rx.instr: First line in men/non-childbearing women (women of child-bearing potential: pregnancy must be avoided for 3 years after stopping — prefer cyclosporine 3–5 mg/kg/day). Baseline and 2–4-weekly lipids, LFT. Cyclosporine: monitor BP and creatinine; methotrexate weekly only

rx.drug: IV fluids / oral fluids as per output
rx.instr: Monitor temperature, pulse, BP, urine output, electrolytes, calcium, albumin
